summary: This document is a hypothesis card (L10) proposing a pre-registered experiment to test whether senescent-cell/SASP clearance causes absolute residual tissue ΔNAD (from a matched NAD-precursor pulse) to shrink while fractional residual ΔNAD (normalized to post-clearance baseline) does not. The claim is currently UNKNOWN/PREDICTION status — no dedicated experiment has been run. Supporting mechanistic literature exists (CD38 gating of NAD, SASP-driven CD38+ macrophage NAD drain, senolysis-mediated CD38 drop and partial NAD rebound), but the dual absolute-vs-fractional residual panel after documented senolysis has not been executed.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis Statement
content_blocks.content: After documented senescent-cell/SASP clearance, absolute residual tissue ΔNAD from a matched NAD-precursor pulse shrinks versus the same pulse without clearance run-in, while fractional residual ΔNAD (normalized to the post-clearance baseline NAD) does not shrink. Pre-registered dual readout: absolute_residual_after < absolute_residual_control outside a no-shrink band AND fractional_residual_after within a hold band of fractional_residual_control. No CD38i arm required. Status: PREDICTION — not yet measured.

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: Subtract-before-add logic: clear SASP-driven CD38+ macrophage load first, then pulse a matched NAD precursor and score both absolute and fractional residual ΔNAD vs post-clearance baseline. Key mechanistic chain: (1) CD38 gates age-related NAD decline and NMN fate; (2) SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that drain tissue NAD; (3) senescent/SASP ablation lowers CD38 and partially restores NAD; (4) ecto-CD38 block raises NAD via an NMN-dependent route. Rebound artifact is the competing story: after clearance, baseline NAD already rises, so absolute ΔNAD from a fixed pulse can shrink while fractional salvage holds — this dissociation is the claim and is not yet measured.

content_blocks.title: Why It Matters / Context
content_blocks.content: Longevity stacks often read absolute NAD gain from NMN/NR after senolysis and treat a smaller absolute Δ as true diminishing returns. This card is distinct from L8 (absolute-shrink alone) and L7/L9 (rebound-definition/stack-surplus cards) — it focuses on dual absolute vs fractional residual on one precursor ± senolysis run-in. Soft-claims: (NMN|NR)∩senolytic∩(absolute|fractional)∩NAD soft-complete = 0; dual residual panel remains UNKNOWN. L5–L9 are explicitly stated to not be proof of this dissociation.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Supporting Literature
content_blocks.content:
Four key references cited:
1. PMID 27304511 (Camacho-Pereira 2016, Cell Metab, DOI 10.1016/j.cmet.2016.05.006, PMC4911708): Age-related NAD↓ requires CD38; CD38 is the major in vivo NMN-degrading activity. Status: LITERATURE (confirmed).
2. PMID 33199924 (Covarrubias 2020, Nat Metab, DOI 10.1038/s42255-020-00305-3, PMC7908681): SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that reduce tissue NAD. Status: LITERATURE (confirmed).
3. PMID 33199925 (Chini 2020, Nat Metab, DOI 10.1038/s42255-020-00298-z, PMC8752031): Senescent/SASP ablation ↓CD38 and partially restores NAD; ecto-CD38 block raises NAD NMN-dependently. Noted as rebound-definition prior, NOT a dual residual panel.
4. PMID 35263032 (Tarragó 2022, Aging Cell, DOI 10.1111/acel.13589, PMC9009115): CD38i 78c improves median survival/healthspan in aged mice (~10% median survival increase); monotherapy only — not an absolute-vs-fractional precursor ± senolysis panel.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Status Summary
content_blocks.content: Measured/confirmed from literature: CD38 gates age NAD/NMN fate; SASP→CD38+ macrophages→tissue NAD↓; clearance ↓CD38 + partial NAD rebound; ecto-block NMN-dependent; 78c aged-mouse benefit as monotherapy. NOT measured: Dual absolute + fractional residual precursor panel after senolysis (soft-complete (NMN|NR)∩senolytic∩(absolute|fractional)∩NAD = 0; adjacent SRN-901/regimen/wood-smoke non-matches). Absolute shrink + fractional hold = PREDICTION only. L5–L9 do not prove this — ranking, single-arm shrink, and stack-surplus cards left absolute vs fractional unmeasured together.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat L5–L9 as proving L10 — ranking/shrink/stack cards never scored absolute and fractional residual together; soft-complete empty ≠ demonstrated dual pattern.
2. Rebound artifact is the competing story — after clearance baseline NAD already rises; absolute Δ can shrink while fractional salvage holds; that dissociation must be measured, not inferred from absolute-only shrink.
3. Incomplete clearance (residual CD38+ macrophages) and Chini clearance/78c monotherapy are not dual residual panels — both absolute and fractional may move for CD38 reasons, not baseline math alone.

content_blocks.title: Proposed Method / Assay Design
content_blocks.content: Method type: propose-assay. Design: Aged tissue or SASP-conditioned system; vehicle vs senolytic/SASP run-in → matched NAD-precursor pulse (NMN or NR); dual residual readout (absolute ΔNAD and fractional ΔNAD normalized to post-clearance baseline). Clearance verification required: CD38 activity + SC/SASP marker confirmation. Tissue targets to lock: WAT/liver. Pre-registration of no-shrink band and hold band thresholds required before execution. No dosing values to be invented.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: Refute if: On the pre-registered dual residual panel after verified clearance, absolute residual does not shrink outside the no-shrink band, OR fractional residual shrinks outside the hold band (both shrink, neither shrinks, or reverse dissociation), when CD38↓ is verified — especially under incomplete clearance or when apparent dissociation is only an assay-definition artifact under the pre-registered absolute/fractional definitions.

content_blocks.title: Ablation / Critical Dependencies
content_blocks.content:
Three critical dependencies identified:
1. Dual absolute + fractional residual precursor panel after documented senolysis/SASP clearance on matched timing — without this, solo-lever LITERATURE cannot show absolute shrink with fractional hold.
2. Documented clearance run-in with CD38↓/partial NAD rebound verification plus post-clearance baseline for fractional normalization — without subtract-first confirmation and a defined post-clearance baseline, the card collapses into absolute-only shrink (L8) or undefined rebound math.
3. L5–L9≠proof + soft-complete-empty≠dual-pattern + rebound-artifact discipline — treating L5–L9 or empty PubMed as already deciding absolute-vs-fractional dissociation would invent a dual residual result left UNKNOWN.

key_findings: Hypothesis L10 is a PREDICTION only — the dual absolute + fractional residual NAD panel after documented senolysis has NOT been experimentally run (execution_status = NOT_RUN).
Soft-complete literature search returned 0 results for (NMN|NR)∩senolytic∩(absolute|fractional)∩NAD — the specific dual readout experiment does not exist in the published literature.

Four supporting mechanistic literature findings confirmed: (1) CD38 gates age NAD decline and NMN fate (PMID 27304511); (2) SASP induces CD38-high macrophages that drain tissue NAD (PMID 33199924); (3) Senolysis/SASP ablation lowers CD38 and partially restores NAD; ecto-CD38 block raises NAD NMN-dependently (PMID 33199925); (4) CD38i 78c improves aged-mouse median survival ~10% as monotherapy (PMID 35263032).
None of the four cited literature references constitute a dual absolute-vs-fractional residual precursor panel — all are mechanistic or single-arm studies.
L5–L9 hypothesis cards (ranking, single-arm shrink, stack-surplus) explicitly do not prove L10's dual absolute-vs-fractional dissociation.

Rebound artifact is the primary competing explanation: post-clearance baseline NAD rise means absolute ΔNAD from a fixed pulse can shrink while fractional salvage holds — this dissociation must be measured, not inferred.

Proposed assay requires: aged tissue or SASP-conditioned system, vehicle vs senolytic/SASP run-in, matched NAD-precursor pulse (NMN/NR), dual residual readout, CD38 activity verification, and pre-registered band thresholds.
Estimated time to refute: 6 weeks. Kill cost tier: 2 (low cost). IP class: subtract-before-add. FTO status: UNKNOWN.
Document tagged NEGATIVE status, indicating the hypothesis is not yet supported by direct experimental evidence.
